description: Elections Commission - Declare that W. A. Susanthasiri as a member of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's failure to attend meetings, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member, which falls under the Elections classification category.
